The constant is Config.FMT_TIME_ZONE

JSTL Formatting

Tags 3.0 chapter 14 and 15 examples

Not well formed (<jsp-version>2.0</jsp.version>), fn:substring with two arguments, param:userName with a colon, •, $customer/[location='UK'] is not XPath 1.0

JSTL Functions, JSTL SQL and XML, TLDs and EL Functions

Tags 3.0: "requires a Jakarta Server Pages 3.0 container" and EL 4.0

Stale; the library runs on Pages 4.0 and EL 6.0, and the cross references (EL section 1.23, Pages 1.8.2) are garbled

JSTL Core

Tags 3.0: only jakarta.tags.* documented

The 3.0.1 implementation jar still ships the JSTL 1.0 and 1.2 descriptors, so the java.sun.com URIs resolve; http://xmlns.jcp.org/jsp/jstl/* does not

JSTL 1.0 to 3.0: the Library URIs, JSTL I18n and Messages

The Jakarta EE Tutorial pages for Pages and Tags

The Pages page is a stub that says Pages "has been archived in favor of Facelets"; the Tags page says "a subset of Jakarta Tags has been archived" without naming it, while SQL, XML and formatting are still in the Tags 3.0 specification; both link to the Java EE 5 tutorial (javax.*, JSP 2.1, JSTL 1.2), still the last complete official tutorial

JSTL SQL and XML, Introduction and History

Tomcat Documentation Against the Container

Documentation Observed on 11.0.26 Page

Jasper How-To: fork is true by default; keepgenerated and the "keep" in its name

The stock conf/web.xml sets fork to false on the jsp servlet; keepgenerated defaults to true, so generated source stays in work/; compilerSourceVM and compilerTargetVM default to 17, a value of 8 is raised to 17, and JspC -help still prints 1.8

Jasper Configuration and Precompilation, Testing and Debugging

Jasper How-To: addWebXmlMappings

The Ant task needs webXmlInclude as well, otherwise NullPointerException in JspC.mergeIntoWebXml; recompileOnFail retried after about 4 seconds, not at the next access; enablePooling took effect as a servlet init-param; the tag handler pool classes read three more parameters than documented

Jasper Configuration and Precompilation, Custom Tags: Classic

Error Report Valve documentation

Declared in a META-INF/context.xml pipeline it writes the report before the host dispatches <error-page> entries, so every <error-page> stopped working

Error Handling

Manager documentation and tutorials

Session persistence across restarts is off unless configured (pathname default null); older tutorials assume SESSIONS.ser

Servlet Fundamentals

Messages of the JSP translator

Several errors show a raw resource key or an unsubstituted {0} (jsp.error.page.badCombo, jsp.error.setProperty.invalid, Duplicate bean name: [{0}]); a second request after a translation failure can report ClassNotFoundException: org.apache.jsp.<page>

Directives, Standard Actions, Syntax, Comments and Escaping

Jetty operations guide, JSP page

Names org.eclipse.jetty.jsp.JettyJspServlet where 12.1.14 has org.eclipse.jetty.ee11.jsp.JettyJspServlet; its parameter table uses the GlassFish spellings (genStrAsCharArray, scratchDir, mappedFile)

Jasper Configuration and Precompilation

Spring reference, JSP chapter

The sample output of the form tags is out of date for 7.0.9 (<form id="book" ...>, the marker field value, <span id="title.errors">) and it still documents the deprecated mvc: XML namespace; Boot 4.1.1 manages Tomcat 11.0.24 while 11.0.26 is current

Spring MVC with JSP

Struts Documentation Against 7.4.0

The documentation of the Core Developer Guide, the Tag Developer Guide and the plugin pages was largely written for the 2.x line, and the table keeps to what was verified by running 7.4.0.

Documentation Verified on 7.4.0 Page

Many pages (action configuration, localization, interceptors, results, exception handling, file upload, validation, JSON, CDI, plugins architecture, Security log example)

Still name com.opensymphony.xwork2.* (ActionSupport, Action, Validateable, ObjectFactory, Result, ValidatorSupport, the logger category) or javax.validation and javax.servlet.context.tempdir; the 7.4.0 jar has only org.apache.struts2.* and jakarta.*

Packages, Aware Interfaces and Actions, Actions

Architecture "big picture" and nutshell

Describe FilterDispatcher and ActionContextCleanUp (neither class exists), Servlet API 2.4, JSP API 2.0 and Java 7, and JavaServer Faces components; ActionProxyFactory.setFactory does not exist

Architecture and Request Lifecycle

web-xml page, the 2.0 comparison wiki page, birdseye

Still shows the Java EE 3.1 xmlns.jcp.org descriptor; the comparison table was last updated in 2007; birdseye lists AngularJS and does not mention 6.x and 7.x

Introduction and History, Architecture and Request Lifecycle

Interceptors table

Lists timer, fileUpload, parameterFilter and annotationParameterFilter, none of which is registered in 7.4.0 (<interceptor-ref name="timer"/> makes the application fail at startup), and omits httpMethod; the parameters page spells excludedValuePatterns and excludeValuePatterns and overriding params.excludeParams replaces the built-in exclusions

Interceptors, Parameter Injection

Constants

struts.xwork.chaining.* is struts.chaining.*; the LRU-mode OGNL cache constants are struts.ognl.expressionCacheType and beanInfoCacheType; struts.configuration.files does not exist (the config filter init-param does the job); the Spring class-reloading constants carry the struts.objectFactory.spring. prefix; struts.convention.classLoader.excludeParent is struts.convention.exclude.parentClassLoader; struts.conversion.properties.processor is struts.converter.properties.processor; struts.ognl.allowStaticMethodAccess does not exist

Configuration, Action Chaining, Spring Integration

Configuration load order and static content

default.properties is registered first, not fourth; an application default.properties is never read (struts.properties is); static content is served under /static, not /struts/; with configuration reload on, the first reload leaves /static/* answering 500

Configuration, Deployment and Production

Wildcard mappings

The guide says the last matching pattern wins; the source and a run show the first declared match wins; a regex with braces breaks the matcher; an action class chosen only through {1} is not allowlisted; strict method invocation is "2.3" in one page and "2.5" in another

Wildcard Mappings and Method Invocation

Packages and namespaces

An action not found in a namespace does not fall back to the default namespace in 7.4.0 (only / falls back); a parent package declared later in the file works; abstract-package actions are inherited

Packages and Namespaces

Exception handling

Mappings are searched "first local and then global"; the closest class wins across both lists; an unmapped result is HTTP 404, not 500; with struts.devMode=true an unmapped exception answers 200 with the Problem Report

Exception Handling and Global Results

Value stack, OGNL and tags

OGNL method calls on JDK collections fail silently under the allowlist while the property form works; ${x} in a Struts tag attribute fails at translation; the disallowed-property-names list (parameters, session) does not stop an action getter of that name; the tag reference lists 26 generic tags and the TLD has 27 (number); text('key') in s:i18n prints nothing outside s:text

Value Stack, ActionContext and OGNL, Generic Tags

Java records in OGNL (corrected)

Records are supported, with one limit: qualified paths (isbn.code, top.title, #b.title) and accessor calls (title()) read record components, subject to the OGNL allowlist, while a bare name such as title inside s:iterator stays empty because the stack search looks only for JavaBean getters. The earlier note that records are unsupported is withdrawn

Java Records in OGNL

Themes and UI tags

An ajax theme is still listed and fails with TemplateNotFoundException (HTTP 500); the html5 theme’s "validation and error reporting" renders neither labels nor field errors; the checkbox hidden field is written only with submitUnchecked; the tabIndex attribute is tabindex; lower-case labelposition is written onto the element as an unknown attribute; escapeHtmlTag is escapeHtmlBody

Themes and Templates, UI and Form Tags

FreeMarker and Velocity

attributes.myParameter for a request parameter is Parameters.myParameter; req, res and ognl do not resolve; struts.freemarker.templatesCache.updateDelay defaults are FreeMarker’s own 5 seconds; JspTaglibs fails with NoClassDefFoundError: jakarta/servlet/jsp/el/VariableResolver; a Velocity toolbox location drops $stack and $action

FreeMarker and Velocity Views

Tiles plugin

The listener is StrutsTilesListener (there is no org.apache.tiles.listener.TilesListener); wildcard definition names need the WILDCARD: prefix; ${version.tiles} is not defined; commons-beanutils 1.11.0 must be added or startup fails with NoClassDefFoundError

Tiles and Page Layouts

Validation and Bean Validation

The validation page omits the long and creditcard validators and four annotations; creditcard accepts a wrong checksum; regexp is regex; @Validation does not exist; the Bean Validation example imports javax.validation and the old @Email; a provider is mandatory (without one every URL answers 404); the second sample stack validates before params

Validation, Bean Validation Plugin

Localization and conversion

The i18n interceptor reacts to request_locale only for session storage; the key-hierarchy search peels the first segment only; a {0} in invalid.fieldvalue.* prints literally; a date pattern in a bundle goes through MessageFormat; blank BigDecimal becomes null and not an error; en-US 1,5 becomes 15.0

Localization and I18n, Type Conversion

Execute and Wait, tokens, chaining

executeAndWaitStack does not work for an action that needs parameters or a session; the background thread is <action>_background-process; the token is stored per session and a second s:token of the same name replaces the first; chain.excludes replaces the built-in exclusions; the skipActions setter splits on commas

Double-Submit Tokens and Wait Pages, Action Chaining

File upload and results

@StrutsParameter examples for File setters do nothing without the removed interceptor; the "mx" typo in a message; Retry-After on a 200 static response; the postback result URL-encodes hidden values; headers.X-Book-Count sets no header while headers['X-Book-Count'] does

File Upload and Download, Results and Result Types

REST plugin

The documented setup misses jackson-dataformat-xml; automatic error handling is not JSON (an HTML 500, or the serialised Throwable with status 200); the Accept header ignores quality values; If-Modified-Since is inverted in DefaultHttpHeaders; _method=DELETE on a GET deletes

REST Plugin

JSON, Convention, CDI, Spring and other plugins

The CDI jndiKey constant has no effect; only thread of the documented bean scopes works; fetchMetadata.exemptedPaths compares only the context path; the Async plugin does not complete a request on Tomcat 11; the matchingPattern parameter of the XSLT result is ignored; JasperReports 7 needs jackson-bom 2.22.2

CDI, Other Plugins, JSON Plugin

Security headers, debugging and testing

Fetch Metadata allows a cross-site request when the mode is navigate or the method is GET, and a rejection is the result 403 that gives HTTP 404 unless mapped; ?debug=xml is broken on 7.4.0; devMode -Dstruts.devMode=true is ignored; StrutsTestCase is JUnit 3, the JUnit 4 base is StrutsJUnit4TestCase; StrutsTestCaseHelper disables the allowlist

Security Headers, Debugging, Testing

Security guide

The OGNL sandbox is said not to work with JDK 21 and later (a security manager still installs on 21.0.6 with warnings and JDK 25 refuses the flag); the ambiguous-action-methods section (WW-4405) is historical, the guide’s example runs on 7.4.0; struts.disallowProxyMemberAccess and struts.ognl.enableEvalExpression are undocumented there

Security Hardening

Struts 1 documentation

The Struts 1 documentation is no longer online (/1.x/ and the FAQ answer 404); the press release page is struts1eol-press; the "four non-exclusive paths" of Migration Strategies list three; the "Migration Tools" page describes tools that were never built

Struts 1 (Classic) and Migration

Source: Struts — Core Developer Guide, Struts — Tag Developer Guide, Struts — Security

Two of these rows describe behaviour of released code and not of documentation, and an upgrade should look at them before the plugin is trusted: the REST plugin’s inverted conditional GET (DefaultHttpHeaders.compareIfModifiedSince answered 304 for a client copy older than the resource) and the Async plugin that does not complete a request (see Other Plugins). Both are reported on their plugin pages with the request that shows them.

Pitfalls

Pitfall Symptom Remedy

A javax WAR dropped into Tomcat 10.1 or 11

A filter or listener in web.xml stops the context (NoClassDefFoundError: javax/servlet/Filter, every URL 404); a servlet registered only by annotation deploys silently and answers 404

Convert at the source, with the migration tool ahead of time, or through webapps-javaee; read the log, not the HTTP status (What Happens Without Migration)

Trusting the converted WAR to be modern

The descriptors still name Java EE 8 (xmlns.jcp.org, version="4.0", the 2.1 TLD schema) and the JSTL URIs are unchanged

Plan the source-level migration anyway; the next javax import mixes two namespaces in one application (Conversion Ahead of Time: the Migration Tool)

Converting only the application’s own jars

The tool also converts the jars bundled in WEB-INF/lib, but not libraries installed in Tomcat’s lib directory or other shared locations

Keep libraries in the WAR, or convert the shared jars with the same tool before installing them

JasperException for an old page on the first request

isThreadSafe or jsp:plugin fails at translation, not at startup

Precompile with JspC in the build to find every old page at once (Jasper Configuration and Precompilation)

${bean.class.name} or ${exception.class.name}

Failed to parse the expression

${bean.getClass().getName()}

Expecting EL to work under an old descriptor

${...} printed literally in every page of a WAR whose web.xml is a Servlet 2.3 DTD

Move the descriptor to the schema of the version in use, or set el-ignored to false in a property group

Old JSTL URIs left in place

Nothing fails today (the 3.0.1 jar still resolves them), so they survive into the next library change; xmlns.jcp.org URIs fail immediately

Replace with jakarta.tags.* while the diff is small

fileUpload or timer interceptor references

The whole application fails to start; every URL of the context is 404 and the only trace is Unable to find interceptor class referenced by ref-name in the log

Replace fileUpload with actionFileUpload and drop timer; test the startup, not only a request

Unannotated setters after the move to 7

Parameters silently not bound, no error on the page

Add @StrutsParameter after reviewing each setter; use the transition mode of 7.4.0 while you do it

Plain POJOs on a page after the move to 7

<s:property> prints nothing and the log has a warning about a class that is "not allowlisted"

Add the model package to struts.allowlist.packageNames; do not turn the allowlist off

Old constant names

Silently ignored (struts.xwork.chaining.copyMessages)

Use the 6.0 names from the constants table

action!method links and buttons

404 There is no Action mapped for namespace [/] and action name [books!lend]

Map the method as its own action, or use wildcard method selection with <allowed-methods> placed after the results

A new servlet next to Struts at an extensionless URL

Struts answers 404 for the URL before the servlet is reached

struts.action.extension set to action, or struts.action.excludePattern; update the legacy links

Copying a class from the official Struts documentation

package com.opensymphony.xwork2 does not exist, or a javax.validation import that does not resolve

Take the org.apache.struts2 and jakarta names of Packages, Aware Interfaces and Actions; the documentation page is stale, not the framework

Upgrade Checklist

The checklist is the order that the sections above follow, and each step names what proves it. It assumes the target of this section, Tomcat 11 with Java 21 and Struts 7.4, and takes a legacy javax JSP application with Struts 2.3 as the longest case; a JSP-only application skips the Struts steps.

Before touching the code

  1. Inventory the application: container and Java versions, web.xml version, JSP and JSTL libraries and their URIs, Struts version and plugins, and every third-party jar that still imports javax.*.

  2. Run the tests, and record the answer of ten real URLs with curl; they are the regression suite for everything below.

  3. If the aim is only to run on Tomcat 11 first, convert with the migration tool (webapps-javaee or the command line), run the ten URLs, and stop here for the first release.

Platform and JSP

  1. Change javax.servlet, javax.servlet.jsp and javax.el imports to jakarta.*, the dependencies to jakarta.servlet-api 6.1.0, jakarta.servlet.jsp-api 4.0.0 and jakarta.el-api 6.0.1 (provided), and JSTL to the 3.0 API and the 3.0.1 implementation (Conversion at the Source).

  2. Move web.xml to the 6.1 schema and every TLD to the 4.0 schema; keep version and namespace in step.

  3. Replace the removed Servlet and Pages API (SingleThreadModel, HttpUtils, getValue and friends, EVAL_BODY_TAG, getRootCause, the jakarta.servlet.jsp.el classes) with the replacements of Jakarta Servlet: What Changed and What Was Removed.

  4. Delete isThreadSafe and jsp:plugin; replace .class.name in EL; replace the JSTL URIs with jakarta.tags.*.

  5. Precompile all JSPs with JspC in the build, so translation errors surface at build time.

Struts, in the order of the guides

  1. Move to 2.5.33, then 6.12.0, then 7.4.0, running the ten URLs after each step: filter class and DTD (2.5), tag attributes and the removed s:div (2.5), constants, the Aware interfaces and static method access (6), jakarta, org.apache.struts2, @StrutsParameter, the allowlist, actionFileUpload and the removed plugins (7).

  2. Start the application and read the log from the top: a Struts filter that fails to initialise leaves a running context and a 404 for every URL.

  3. Review every @StrutsParameter you added, every struts.allowlist.* entry, and every place where a DMI link was replaced.

  4. Update the version of every plugin to the one of the core, and set the struts2-bom so that no plugin version is hard-coded.

After

  1. Replace the old descriptor namespaces and URIs that the tool or Tomcat tolerated.

  2. Run the security checks of the section (Security Hardening, Security) and read the security bulletins of the line you are on (Security Bulletins).

  3. Decide what the application is: maintained on JSP and Struts, or on its way to Spring MVC and Thymeleaf (Modernisation Paths), and write the decision next to the version numbers.
